stemMd: The survey used a small, unrepresentative sample of twelve respondents, so the report explicitly treated its broader conclusions as ______, subject to revision after further evidence.
instructionsMd: Select the TWO choices that complete the sentence coherently and give it equivalent meanings.
explanationMd: The report explicitly leaves its broader conclusions open to revision. Provisional and tentative both express that limited certainty; categorical and definitive assert stronger certainty than the sentence allows.

distractorRationale.e: The sample size says nothing about length.
distractorRationale.f: An absolute conclusion conflicts with the caution.
distractorRationale.d: This overstates certainty from the small sample.
distractorRationale.c: Small samples can still be relevant.
